# fastf 3.6.1 — the mouse is yours again

Text could not be selected in the app. It asked the terminal to report the
mouse, and a terminal that reports the mouse hands every drag to the program,
so a plain drag selected nothing. 3.6.0 made that a setting and turned it off
by default. This release takes clicking out altogether.

## Select text, scroll with the wheel

The app never asks the terminal for the mouse now. Drag to select, and copy
the way your terminal copies.

The wheel still scrolls the list, the detail pane and any dialog that scrolls.
On the app's full screen a terminal turns the wheel into arrow keys when no
program has claimed the mouse, and kitty, Konsole, GNOME Terminal, WezTerm,
Alacritty and Windows Terminal all do. xterm does it with its `alternateScroll`
resource.

Nothing is clickable any more. A row, a pane and every command are a key away,
as they always were.

## One setting retired

`mouse`, added in 3.6.0, is gone. `fastf config set mouse` is still accepted
and says it is no longer used, so a script that sets it keeps working, and a
`config.toml` that names it still parses.

Nothing else changed.

Full key list: [docs/cli.md](https://github.com/cristocola/fast-folder/blob/main/docs/cli.md#keys)
